profiles.deleteHint: (long press a profile to delete it)
profiles.deleteMessage:
The profile "{{profile}}" will be removed from this device, along with all data saved locally to access its box: box address, and remembered login and password.

The data on the box itself is not affected. To reconnect, you will need the box ID and your password to create a new profile.
